name: n8n basics: the first workflow
beschreibung: Workflows that run by themselves: everyone opens n8n in their own Agent PC, gets to know triggers, nodes and connections and builds a workflow that sends new items from an RSS feed to their phone via Telegram – tested, published and saved as a file. Course in the series “Agents, MCP apps and n8n”, works without prior knowledge of Hermes; as a 90-minute course or on your own in self-study mode.
zielgruppe: People who want to automate recurring tasks – no programming knowledge needed
voraussetzungen: Bony's Agents version 0.24.0 or later, a computer with at least 8 GB RAM and 40 GB free disk space
Telegram on your phone or computer (your own account)
kosten: none – n8n runs in your own Agent PC, Telegram bots are free
lernziele: explain what a workflow is: trigger, nodes, connections, executions
open n8n in the Agent PC and create your own account
create a Telegram bot and treat its access token like a password
build, test and publish an “RSS → Telegram” workflow
adapt the workflow (another feed, another time, another message)
save a workflow as a file and know where n8n stores its data

lektionen.ziel: Know how the course works and where to get help.
Tell triggers, nodes and connections apart.
n8n is running, your own account is created.

pruefung.aufgabe: An account is created in n8n (“Set up owner account”).
pruefung.geschafft: n8n is running and your account is created.
pruefung.noch_nicht: No account in n8n yet. Double-click “n8n” on the desktop and fill in the “Set up owner account” form. If no page appears, wait a minute and reload.

lektionen.ziel: You have your own Telegram bot – and you know your chat ID.
A published workflow sends new items via Telegram.

pruefung.aufgabe: A published workflow starts with “RSS Feed Trigger” and sends via Telegram.
pruefung.geschafft: Your workflow is published and runs by itself.
pruefung.noch_nicht: No published workflow with “RSS Feed Trigger” and Telegram yet. Is the workflow saved and published at the top right (“Publish”)?

lektionen.ziel: Adapt the workflow on your own.
Save the workflow as a file and know how to continue.

pruefung.aufgabe: An exported workflow with “RSS Feed Trigger” (.json) is in the Downloads folder.
pruefung.geschafft: Your workflow is saved as a file.
pruefung.noch_nicht: No exported workflow file in the Downloads folder yet. In the workflow, top right “…” → “Export JSON”.
